Bea Borres and her former boyfriend Meray Yamada recently appeared together in a candid clip, but she made one thing clear from the beginning: their reunion does not mean they are co-parenting their daughter, Victoria Hope.
READ: Bea Borres reveals the face of her daughter Hope: ‘Too beautiful to not share’ Before bringing Meray into the frame, Bea immediately gave a disclaimer behind their reunion.
CEBU, Philippines — Nagkita pag-usab atubangan sa camera ang aktres ug content creator nga si Bea Borres ug iyang ex-boyfriend nga si Meray Yamada alang sa usa ka online content.

Sa YouTube vlog nga “Hot Moms Bake with Jam Magno,” gipakita ni Bea ang mubo nga video clip diin iyang gipatilaw si Meray sa hinimo niya nga cake.Suma pa ni Bea, gituyo niyang ilakip si Meray sa vlog aron madugangan ang online engagement ug mokita siya niini.Aduna na’y anak sila Bea ug Meray nga ginganlan og Hope .
In a YouTube vlog titled "Hot Moms Bake with Jam Magno," Bea inserted a short clip toward the latter part of the video, where she let Meray try the cake she baked.
At the end of the video, their Baby Hopea appeared and bonded with Bea and Meray.
The former couple’s unexpected interaction was featured as a “bonus clip” in Bea’s latest vlog, which she later reposted on Facebook and quickly caught the attention of netizens.
The three of them briefly appeared together and smiled at the camera.
In her Facebook post, the celebrity mom expressed how she’d rather be making content with her ex-partner, Meray Yamada, than promote online gambling.
